write_up: Your resume points clearly to ICU nursing: you moved from telemetry at Saguaro Community Hospital to the medical ICU at Desert Valley Medical Center. A recruiter can see your patient load and the treatments you manage, so there's enough here to move forward with a few questions.

The direct-care line is a strong model. It names both the patients you care for and the unit you work in. Your Arizona license and CCRN are easy to find, and Education follows your nursing experience.
Let's build on that detail in the charge nurse and sepsis committee lines. A little more about what you handle in each role would show the work beyond bedside care.
